title: Director of Fabrication
text:
**DIRECTOR OF FABRICATION** 
Sargent Electric is a leading specialty contractor focused on electrical, instrumentation, wireless, utility, and low voltage systems. Founded in Pittsburgh in 1907, we operate from 8 locations across the Midwest, Mid-Atlantic and Northeast, delivering projects nationwide for our strategic customers. 
We support the breadth of client needs — from routine 24/7 service and emergency restoration to their largest and most complex projects. Our proven safety record, technical depth, and longstanding client relationships have made us a partner of choice for Fortune 500 companies, leading general contractors, and EPC contractors. 
We are seeking a **DIRECTOR OF FABRICATION** to support our Mission Critical team. 
 
**WHAT YOU'LL DO:**

* **Champion Safety Culture.** Set the standard through visible, consistent leadership. Ensure fabrication, material handling, equipment operation, and facility activities are planned and performed in alignment with company requirements and applicable safety standards.
* **Lead from the Facility Floor.** This is a working leadership role. Maintain a consistent presence in the facility, understand the daily heartbeat of the operation, engage the team directly, and act quickly when conditions require attention.
* **Facility Operations and Execution.** Lead the day-to-day operation of an 80,000 square-foot fabrication facility, including fabrication, modular assembly, receiving, inventory, shipping, equipment, maintenance, and facility services.
* **Production Planning.** Translate the demand and released work scopes of multiple regional projects into practical weekly and monthly production plans. Align labor, materials, equipment, floor space, and support resources with field installation sequence and committed delivery dates.
* **Reliable Flow and Delivery.** Monitor backlog, throughput, labor performance, work in process, capacity, and on-time completion. Balance work across production areas, remove constraints, and communicate risks before they become missed commitments.
* **Field First Fabrication and DFMI.** Partner with preconstruction, planning, modeling, procurement, operations, and field leadership to turn coordinated information into fabrication ready work. Help advance repeatable assemblies, kitting, bills of material, and installation-ready work packages.
* **Quality and Standards.** Establish practical inspection, testing, release, and nonconformance processes that protect workmanship, accuracy, traceability, and project requirements. Maintain standards with discipline while remaining agile when project or market conditions require a different path.
* **Inventory, Warehousing, and Logistics.** Maintain material visibility and inventory accuracy from receipt through shipment. Improve packaging, loading, transportation, delivery tracking, and site handoff while reducing shortages, damage, excess inventory, obsolete material, and double handling.
* **Financial and Operational Stewardship.** Manage the facility operating budget and the cost drivers within the role, including labor, equipment, maintenance, occupancy, material handling, logistics, and overhead. Provide forecasts and clear explanations of material variances.
* **Build and Develop the Team.** Recruit, organize, coach, and retain production and support personnel. Set clear accountabilities, staffing and training plans, and performance expectations while building a culture of safety, respect, urgency, craftsmanship, teamwork, and ownership.
* **Continuous Improvement.** Apply practical Lean methods, standardized work, visual management, and structured problem solving. Improve flow, first pass quality, cycle time, productivity, and usable capacity without creating process for the sake of process.
* **Progressive Entrepreneurial Leadership.** Bring courage of conviction, sound judgment, and a bias for action. Challenge the status quo when the facts support it, remain open to better ideas, and adapt tooling, methods, layout, and staffing to changing customer and market needs.
* **Performance Visibility and Accountability.** Create and maintain a focused operating dashboard including KPIs that drive decisions, including safety, quality, backlog, staffing, throughput, delivery, inventory, cost, and improvement actions.

Any additional duties and responsibilities as delegated by Sargent Electrical Management 
 
**WHAT YOU'LL BRING:**

* Demonstrated ability to convert forecasted and released demand into executable production plans.
* Working knowledge of electrical construction materials, means and methods, field installation sequencing.
* Excellent written communication skills. Proficiency with computers, particularly Microsoft Office applications, including the ability to type.
* Strong interpersonal and verbal communication skills and the ability to effectively communicate with a wide range of diverse individuals.
* The ability to work efficiently under tight time frames, the ability to respond to requests in a timely manner, and effective communication as a team player.
* Understanding of the importance of multi-tasking.

 
**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Manufacturing, Operations, Business, or a related discipline. Relevant trade, field, fabrication, or operations experience may be considered in lieu of a degree.
* Minimum five (5) years of experience in fabrication, modular construction, manufacturing, industrial operations, or a closely related environment (electrical preferred).
* Minimum three (3) years leading fabrication, production, warehouse, or industrial operations personnel.

 
**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Experience starting, scaling, reorganizing, or materially improving a fabrication, manufacturing, or distribution operation.
* Practical experience with Lean manufacturing, standardized work, and continuous improvement.
* Experience with ERP, production planning, inventory management, fabrication tracking, and reporting systems.
* Lean, Six Sigma, CM-Lean, or comparable continuous improvement training.

 
**TRAVEL REQUIREMENTS**

* Travel to project sites, training, trade shows, and conferences as required.

 
**WHY JOIN SARGENT?**

* Established, growing company with a strong industry reputation
* Collaborative, team-driven environment
* Competitive compensation based on experience

 
**EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER** 
*Sargent Electric Company is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all qualified individuals in accordance with applicable federal, state, and local laws.*
